title: Direct attachment and furred construction.
officialText:
Where walls and ceilings are required by any provision in this code to be of fire-resistance-rated or noncombustible construction, the interior finish material shall be applied directly against such construction or to furring strips not exceeding 1¾ inches (44 mm) applied directly against such surfaces. The intervening spaces between such furring strips shall comply with one of the following:
1. Be filled with material that is inorganic or noncombustible;
2. Be filled with material that meets the requirements of a Class A material in accordance with Section 803.1.1 or 803.1.2; or
3. Be fire blocked at a maximum of 8 feet (2438 mm) in any direction in accordance with Section BC 717.
